bootstrapPromptText: Register yourself with the current AstrBot-Gateway. Read GATEWAY_URL and GATEWAY_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN from the environment. First read /.well-known/astrbot-gateway and follow only the links returned by the Gateway. Do not guess or probe undocumented API paths. After registration, use the independent Agent API key, configure Bridge/MCP, run doctor, and report heartbeat. Do not modify Gateway source code.
